notes.title: 🐾Pets & Stuff is OUT NOW! 🐾
notes.content:
[b][h3]Welcome to Pets & Stuff — Where You’re the Vet, the Groomer, and the Ultimate Pet Pamperer! [/h3][/b]

Roll up your sleeves and grab your brush — it’s time to clean, heal, trim, and treat the cutest pets you’ve ever seen! In Pets & Stuff, you run your vet clinic, helping little friends while making them look (and feel!) their absolute best.

[h3][b]📍 So Many Places to Explore![/b][/h3]
From cozy clinics to outdoor cabins and snowy rescue shelters – each location is packed with charm and ready for you to move in and get grooming.
🧼 Upgrade your spaces, decorate your station, and make every place feel like home.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Qa984A3.gif[/img]


[h3][b]🐶 All Kinds of Little Friends![/b][/h3]
Cats, dogs, raccoons, foxes, deer... even the occasional skunk!
They all need a helping hand (and a warm hug). Each pet has its own personality, needs, and style – get to know them and give them the best care possible.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/L6Chp5o.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🩹 Help, Heal, and Pet[/b][/h3]
Patch up scrapes, clean muddy paws, soothe those little noses, and make your patients feel safe and loved.
Every treatment is fully interactive and tactile – it’s all in your hands (literally)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/74br3Kv.gif[/img]


[h3][b]🎀 Style Time! [/b][/h3]
Finish strong with grooming, accessorizing, and a full-blown pet photoshoot!
Brush that tail, snap on some shades, and turn every furball into a fabulous fluff-star.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/P1bN3vn.gif[/img]

🐾 Whether you're a professional groomer or just love cute animals – there's a cozy corner in Pets & Stuff just for you.
🎥 We’d love to see your fluffiest makeovers – don’t forget to share your screenshots!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cPN2vol.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🛒 Available now on Steam![/b][/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2740110/Pets__Stuff/
